entries.answer:
KGMU mein canteen ya kisi bhi anya tender/contract ke liye apply karne ki prakriya adhikarik roop se university ki website par uplabdh tenders ke madhyam se hoti hai.

Canteen ya anya sevaon ke liye apply karne ke liye ye kadam uthayein:

1.  **Official Website Check Karein:** KGMU ki adhikarik website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar 'Tenders' section ko niyamit roop se dekhte rahein. 
2.  **Tender Notice:** Jab bhi canteen ya kisi anubandh (contract) ki avashyakta hoti hai, KGMU uske liye tender nikalta hai. Aapko us tender notice ko dhyan se padhna hoga jismein eligibility criteria, apply karne ki antim tithi (deadline), aur required documents ki jaankari di hoti hai.
3.  **Application Process:** Tender document mein di gayi instructions ke anusar, aapko apni bid (prastav) tayyar karni hogi. Aksar ye prakriya **GeM (Government e-Marketplace)** portal ke madhyam se hoti hai, isliye aapka GeM par panjikrit (registered) hona avashyak hai.
4.  **Sampark Karein:** Aap adhik jaankari ke liye KGMU ke **PRO Office** (9415007710) ya sambhandhit vibhag se sampark kar sakte hain taaki aapko sahi margdarshan mil sake.

**Dhyan dein:** KGMU mein kisi bhi prakar ki seva ke liye sirf official tenders aur GeM portal ke madhyam se hi aavedan swikar kiye jaate hain. Kisi bhi vyakti ya madhyasth (middleman) ke chakkar mein na padein.

entries.question: Book an Appointment
entries.answer:

*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, and follow the steps to book your department/date/time. You will need to pay the ₹50 registration fee online and download your slip.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same process as the ORS portal.
*   **SMS:** Send `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number to receive an OTP, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times, as the registration counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.
